title: Separable elements remain separable after adjoining another base field
statement: Let $K\subseteq M\subseteq\Omega$ be inclusions of fields [def-pc-field-extension]. Write $\Omega_{s,K}=\{x\in\Omega:x\text{ is separable algebraic over }K\}$ and $\Omega_{s,M}=\{x\in\Omega:x\text{ is separable algebraic over }M\}$, the relative separable closures [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then $M(\Omega_{s,K})\subseteq\Omega_{s,M}$. In particular, if $U\subseteq\Omega$ consists of elements separable algebraic over $K$, then the field $M(U)$ generated by $M$ and $U$ is separable algebraic over $M$. No algebraicity assumption on $M/K$ or $\Omega/K$ is imposed.
